draft.title: Graduate Secretary
draft.position_summary: Provides administrative support to the Manager of Academic and Administrative Services, and the Graduate Program Chair. Responds to requests for Graduate Program information such as admission, registration, courses, and grading. Coordinates graduate program admissions and scholarships and processes awards. Prepares graduate program progress reviews, general correspondence, and reports. Updates databases and spreadsheets.

duties.statement: Assists in the production of special reports as requested by the Manager, Academic & Administrative Services (e.g., tracking enrolment, instructional activities, etc.)

model.title: Graduate Program Administrative Assistant
model.position_summary: Provides comprehensive administrative support to the Manager of Academic and Administrative Services and the Graduate Program Chair. The role ensures accurate processing of graduate admissions, scholarships, course scheduling, and graduation procedures while maintaining confidential records and responding to program inquiries. By preparing reports, managing databases, and coordinating committee activities, the incumbent facilitates smooth operation of graduate programs and upholds university policies and standards.
